entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Private extension methods are shown as null-unaware #80648
    Backlog
  • Extension blocks: extension method called from constructor is marked as unused #80645
    Backlog
  • Restore.cmd does not complete #80644
  • False-positive for "Simplify check" when the check relies on overloaded true/false operators #80640
    Backlog
  • Local constant usage isn't classified correctly #80622
    Backlog

Closed

  • Autocompletion does not offer `where` after extension declaration #80636
  • Autocompletion offers metadata names for extension properties and operators #80637
  • Syntax highlighting and Quick Info don't work on generic extension method invocations when the receiver is `dynamic` #80639
  • Missing XML doc comments on Incremental Generator public API #79932
    Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-11109.269 #80634
  • "Generate abstract method" adds disallowed async modifier #80628
  • Fix for CS0449 removes line breaks between constraints #80630
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11109.63 #80620
  • Availability of Microsoft.Net.Compilers.Toolset on NuGet matching VS2026 Insiders #80213
    Next

PullRequests

Created

  • [WIP] Improve diagnostics for unsafe in iterators feature #80650
  • Do not run the 'fully qualify' fixer on sourcce-generated docs #80649
    Area-IDE
  • Add xcopy-msbuild version to global.json #80647
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix invalid workspace state when decompilation cancelled. #80643
    VSCode
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
  • Fix ref safe context of assignments to be their RHS #80633
    Area-Compilers
  • Use core compiler on netfx hosts with toolset package #80631
    Area-Compilers
  • WIP #80623
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Handle potential null in extension lookup #80621
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Initial spike for file-based programs editor features #80410
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Build BuildHost against net8.0 #80641
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Fix `where` keyword completion for extension declarations with type parameters #80638
    VSCode, Next
  • Allow IBackgroundWorkIndicatorContext to be disposed on any thread. #80632
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Update dotnet-format instructions #80642
    Next
  • PEDeltaAssemblyBuilder: Don't freeze `_needsGeneratedAttributes` compilation state. #80600
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add XML doc comments to Incremental Generator public API #80609
    Area-Compilers, Documentation
  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Next
  • Fix "Generate abstract method" adding disallowed async modifier #80629
    VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80627
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80625

Updated

  • Add limited support for binarylogger to MSBuildWorkspace #80120
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fbp live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extend `ToArray` optimization when targeting read-only collection types #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality
  • Make string concat assert more precise #80619
    Area-Compilers
  • Disable CS8002 warning when targeting .NET Core #80596
  • Annotate MS.CA and MS.CA.C# for trimming #66519
    Area-Compilers, 18.4
  • Optimise allocations in `AssertEx.NormalizeWhitespace` and `OperationTreeVerifier.Verify` #75202
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged, 18.3
  • Start of enabling runtime async tests #80362
    Area-Compilers
  • Add IDE/Compiler specific custom instructions #80617
  • Extensions: fix betterness with params #80531
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Ensure `LspWorkspaceManager` returns solutions without misc document when file moved #80535
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Further clean up Roslyn's package load #80598
    Area-IDE
  • Use proper "unsafe" context while binding type in explicit interface specifier #80610
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546

  • Better codegen for record's `Equals` member #79966
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
